lines.x: Be your bodyguard? Okay.
I wonder how papa is doing nowadays... But, I trust the mayor to keep her word, so it should be fine.

Though Dossoles is noisy and filled with bad people, life there is still a lot better there than the rest of Bolívar... Mhm? You haven't been there yet, Doctor? Hehe, Let's go together next time then.
Phew… Staying inside all day is so stuffy. Doctor, let's go get some fresh air up on the deck, okay? I'm sure you must be tired from working for so long.
Doctor, do you enjoy all this fighting and killing? I don't, not really. But I guess I've been around it too long, and done too much myself... I'm kinda used to it…
Getting stronger is nice, but I can't think of what to do once I'm stronger... Doctor, how do you decide what you want to do?
For the longest time, Papa didn't want me to help him. You know, my personality isn't really suited for what he does. But still... I gave it my all, because he took me in as his daughter.
Doctor, doctor, can I scooch a little closer to you? Well, the office is so big, it feels a bit empty and lonely sitting so far from you… Can I?

Doctor, I don't think you can fight at all, but you're just as reliable as papa. It feels like I can just follow your orders, and I won't ever have to think for myself. Oh...? But for me, that's a good thing.
What does the Doctor look like under that mask? Let's sneak a peek…
Hello, Doctor. I'm Rafaela, the one Miss Ch'en introduced. I'll be formally joining Rhodes Island today. Uh, code name? Mhmm... You can call me La Pluma.
Hmm... Wonder if I can really do this.
Doctor, did you need me for something? Mm? A promotion? Hmm... did I do something special?
Doctor, I'm stronger than before? Really? Hmm… I'm not sure I feel anything different… But if you say so, then it must be true.
Mm? Time for a mission?
I'm kinda good at leading the way.
Where are we going this time?
Now then, I can't afford to get sidetracked.
Woah, Doctor... Don't scare me like that.
I'll follow your instructions.
Okay.
All I have to do is keep them from passing, right?
Haah!
I'll cut you in two!
It's tricky.
Let's finish this.
Woah... I didn't think I could accomplish a mission like this…
Doctor, you're incredible!
Doctor, leave the rest to me. I'll get them.
Doctor, this way. We need to run.
The corridors in Rhodes Island are so wide…
Mm-hm?
What's the Doctor doing now? Let's go take a look.
Arknights.

Happy new year, Doctor. Rhodes Island is so lively during New Year. Woo, look over there, the operators have prepared so many games. It looks like a lot of fun... Doctor, which one should I try? Can you choose for me?
Oh, Doctor. How did you end up right in front of me?

Doctor, a lot of Operators ask me to mix special drinks for their birthdays. Each one is custom-made based on their preferences and the weather that day. Would you like one too, Doctor? Hehe, but only after you've finished your work.
Here you are, Doctor! I was just helping the others with the decorations. I did a whole wall by myself. Celebrations like this are so much fun. Oh, do you have a moment? I'd love to show you my work.
